# Square Peg Pizzeria

> Wood-fired pizza made from scratch daily, with 10 locations in Connecticut and Delray Beach, Florida. Online ordering for pickup and delivery, catering, a wood-fired food truck, Tuesday night fundraisers, and a rewards app.

## Locations
- [Glastonbury](https://squarepegpizzeria.com/locations/glastonbury-ct/): 1001 Hebron Ave, Glastonbury, CT 06033 · (860) 286-0415 · order: https://squarepegpizzeria.com/order/square-peg-pizzeria
- [East Hartford](https://squarepegpizzeria.com/locations/east-hartford-ct/): 130 Long Hill St, East Hartford, CT 06108 · (860) 509-4221 · order: https://squarepegpizzeria.com/order/square-peg-pizzera-east-hartford
- [Vernon](https://squarepegpizzeria.com/locations/vernon-ct/): 226 Talcottville Rd, Vernon, CT 06066 · (860) 926-0088 · order: https://squarepegpizzeria.com/order/square-peg-pizzeria-vernon-226-talcottville-rd
